CustomField.label: Predicted Auction Cost
CustomField.description: MFL_AAV__c shrunk toward what similarly-ranked players go for (in proportion to how wide, and therefore how unreliable, its AAV_Min__c/AAV_Max__c spread is - see MFLManagePlayers.confidenceAdjustedAuctionValues()), then scaled to this league's real combined auction pool: number of teams times Draft_Settings__c.Auction_Budget__c, NOT the per-team budget alone (MFL's $1000 baseline is the whole league's pool, per MFL's own API docs - see MFLManagePlayers.predictedAuctionCost()). Computed by MFLManagePlayers.computeTiers() on every sync - no longer a live formula, since the confidence adjustment needs the whole position group, not just this record. Only as fresh as the last sync, same as Tier_Auction__c.
